description: Average centipawns given away on this side's moves. Lower means more accurate play and usually a higher rating.
Average centipawns given away on this side's moves at ply 20 or earlier.
Share of this side's moves that lost at least 200 centipawns. This was the strongest signal when many games were averaged.
Average centipawns the opponent gave away. A strong subject tends to raise this number, so it is not forced up or down.
Share of this side's moves that matched Stockfish's top move at the training depth.
Average centipawns the opponent gave away from positions within 150 centipawns of equal.
Share of this side's moves that lost at least 100 centipawns (one pawn).
Typical centipawn loss on this side's moves, less pulled by one huge blunder than the mean.
Average number of legal moves on this side's turns. Open positions have more choices; cramped or lost positions have fewer.
Share of the opponent's moves that lost at least 200 centipawns.
Average material from this side's view after ply 20, ignoring the last 6 plies so the final result does not leak in. Being ahead here tends to mark the higher-rated side.
How much the engine evaluation swung across this side's moves.
How uneven this side's think times were: the spread divided by the mean. The first move is left out.
Average centipawns given away on this side's moves that started within 150 centipawns of equal.
Average material from this side's view through ply 20.
How often this side captured.
How long the game lasted, in plies.
Clock left after this side's last move, as a fraction of the estimated game length.
How many moves this side played.
Seconds added after each of this side's moves.
Average win-percent the opponent gave away on their moves.
Share of this side's moves after ply 20 that were played in under 2 seconds.
Highest acc_mean across this player's games in the subset.
1 if this side castled, 0 otherwise.
Average centipawns given away on moves played with at least a fifth of the estimated time still on the clock.
Spread of blunder_rate across this player's games in the subset.
Average think time as a fraction of the estimated game length. This side's first move is left out.
Highest blunder_rate across this player's games in the subset.
How often this side gave check.
How often this side promoted.
Lowest wpl_mean across this player's games in the subset.
Lowest cpl_mean across this player's games in the subset.
Spread of acc_mean across this player's games in the subset.
Share of this side's moves that were knight moves.
Average centipawns given away on this side's moves after ply 60.
Share of this side's moves that were queen moves.
Base time on the clock at the start, in seconds.
Share of this side's balanced-position moves that lost at least 100 centipawns.
Share of this side's moves played with under a tenth of the estimated game time left.
The ply on which this side castled.
Share of this side's moves that were bishop moves.
Share of this side's moves that were king moves, including castling.
Lowest acc_mean across this player's games in the subset.
1 for kingside castling, 0 for queenside, empty if they never castled.
Knights and bishops that had left their start squares by ply 10.
Share of this side's moves that were rook moves.
Highest cpl_mean across this player's games in the subset.
Average move accuracy on this side's moves, from 0 to 100. 100 would mean every move matched the engine's win-percent change.
1 when the time control parsed and every move by this side has a clock, otherwise 0.
Whether this row is White, so the guess can differ by color.
Lowest blunder_rate across this player's games in the subset.
Average move accuracy of the opponent, from 0 to 100. This is how cleanly they played, not their rating.
Average win-percent given away on this side's moves. Equal positions lose more from the same centipawn error than positions that are already decided.
Spread of wpl_mean across this player's games in the subset.
Highest wpl_mean across this player's games in the subset.
Share of this side's moves that were pawn moves.
Spread of cpl_mean across this player's games in the subset.
